correctness.rationale: For all r≥2 and algebraically closed k of any characteristic, XiXj=0 forces I=sum images⊂K=common kernel and in dimension 3 any nonzero tuple has either dim I=1 or codim K=1. Incidence maps over P²/P²-dual have 2r-dimensional fibers and are proper onto two distinct 2r+2 dimensional rational components. At overlap a unique flag L⊂W and an r-vector of scalars produce Z of dimension r+3; unique incidence parameters make smooth component charts outside Z. Linearization XiYj+YiXj=0 at (E13), (E12,E13), transposed representative, and origin yields respectively 4r+1, 2r+2, 2r+2, 9r; elementary GL3 and GLr actions reduce the entire strata to these profiles. tr Xi vanishes on all geometric solutions, so is in the radical, but Y1=E22 is tangent at E13 with derivative 1, proving a nonzero local nilpotent at each nonzero Z point; at the origin a linear trace cannot lie in the homogeneous quadratic ideal. Outside Z tangent dimension equals local dimension, so local rings are regular and reduced. The Fq counts follow from unique nonzero line/plane/flag incidences and inclusion-exclusion. Independent complete enumeration of r=2 pairs at q=2,3 and independent Jacobian ranks at p=2,3,5,7 for r=2,3,4,5 corroborate the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The scheme of representations of a radical-square-zero local algebra is a standard moduli object; its reduced components do not determine infinitesimal deformations. An exact support theorem for the nilradical, a complete all-r tangent stratification (2r+2 off overlap, 4r+1 at nonzero overlap, 9r at zero), and a geometric codimension r−1 description of the affected locus are substantive deformation/singularity invariants. The finite-field flag intersection enumeration is a natural quantitative companion, though simple once incidence geometry is known. This is a motivated complete classification within a fixed natural dimension, not an arbitrary matrix slice or a claim to new reduced component counts.

final_claim: For every r≥2 over an algebraically closed field of any characteristic, the quadratic scheme XiXj=0 on (M3)^r has reduced support the union of two rational components dimension 2r+2. Their flag-proportional intersection Z is irreducible dimension r+3 and is exactly the local nonreduced locus of the original scheme and the singular locus of the reduced scheme. Original-scheme tangent dimensions are 2r+2 outside Z, 4r+1 on nonzero Z, and 9r at zero. For every finite field Fq, with s=q²+q+1, #Z=1+s(q+1)(q^r−1) and #Rr=1+2s(q^(2r)−1)−s(q+1)(q^r−1).
